reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of grain-boundary-mediated diffusion of Al and Ti from different sources (P5, P13, P36) and applies it to a new, specific additively manufactured alloy (Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3) to predict a degradation mechanism (intergranular cracking from brittle oxide scales) that is not reported in the passages. It also proposes a controlled oxidizing vs. reducing atmosphere comparison to test this mechanism, which is a new experimental design not suggested in the provided literature.
